    How to Cut JavaScript Bundle Size by 60%

    A repeatable process to cut JavaScript bundle size by 60%: measure, split, replace heavy dependencies and delete dead code — without losing features.

    Sep 5, 2026•6 min read

    Built as an SEO test bench

    Every page ships server-rendered HTML, one stylesheet, ~8KB of JavaScript, full schema.org markup and a clean internal link graph — so ranking experiments measure your content, not your framework.

    Static HTML, zero hydration

    Crawlers get the full text on first byte. No client-side rendering to debug in Search Console.

    Schema on every template

    BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList, CollectionPage, FAQPage and WebSite + SearchAction are generated automatically.

    Instant on-site search

    A prebuilt JSON index powers keyword search with highlighting — useful for readers, and a strong engagement signal.

    3D without the payload

    The hero visuals are hand-written canvas projection, so there is no 600KB WebGL library hurting LCP.
